data_provenance: IIM CAT pattern as used in 2024–2025 sessions (CAT 2025 conducted 30 Nov 2025 by IIM Kozhikode): 3 fixed sections × 40 minutes (non-transferable), VARC 24 + DILR 22 + QA 22 = 68 questions. MCQ +3/−1; TITA +3/0. Confirm against current-year CAT notification/mock before production use.
important_caveat: IIMs can rebalance section counts or MCQ/TITA mix without a formal syllabus PDF. Prefer seeded ExamPaperPattern documents when present; this file is the seed source for 2026.

exam_day.note: CAT is a single computer-based test with three timed sections. Slot-wise papers differ; pattern totals are stable.

Paper_1.label: CAT Slot Paper
Paper_1.overall_difficulty: Adaptive-feel difficulty; DILR and Algebra often make-or-break

section_1_single_correct.note: Typical MCQ share per ~22-question section (VARC leans more MCQ; QA/DILR mix MCQ+TITA).

question_types_note: CAT uses single-correct MCQ and TITA only. No multi-correct or matrix-match.
